[RLOW.4.6.6.5] **Combination with rule-level rate_mod is
rejected.** Rule-level `cooldown` and
per-call `cooldown:` would create overlapping
trackers (rule-keyed + synthetic-keyed). The
validator emits
`DS_VALIDATE_CALL_COOL_INSIDE_RULE_COOL`. Authors
who want both can split into multiple rules.
